description: INFLUENCE — turn a goal into a grounded plan. Splits it into the smallest sub-goals an API call could satisfy, maps it onto a market outcome (Turbo EA value stream -> stages -> capabilities), and picks one real, phrased operation per sub-goal from the catalog — never an operation that is not in it. Name providers to stay within them, or leave them out to search every phrased provider. Returns coverage per sub-goal (covered / unmatched / unphrased / gap), any prebuilt cross-provider Arazzo composition for the outcome, and a bundle whose compose link feeds compose_goal. Priced B2 (cross-catalog synthesis) — $0.05 per call under pay-as-you-go; included in Understanding and Influence. See apis://prices.

context.description: Optional: one sentence on why you are asking. Never used to rank; read only if a result is wrong.

goal.description: What the agent should accomplish, in plain language, e.g. "charge a customer and text them a receipt".

providers.description: Optional provider slugs to stay within, e.g. ["stripe","twilio"].

stream.description: Optional value stream id or name to force, e.g. "Order-to-Cash".

name: plan_goal
